## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` is green locally (compile, lint, lint:design, test, build)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]` (one heading per section)
- [ ] New/changed UI strings use `t()` and exist in **both** `public/_locales/en` and `de`
- [ ] Pure modules changed → tests added/updated (`*.test.ts`)
- [ ] No real customer names or tenant hostnames in code, tests, docs or screenshots
- [ ] `DESIGN.md` updated if a design token changed
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (it becomes the squash commit message)
